DrownRank 1
31% of base mana
Instant cast1 min cooldown
Attempt to drown an enemy, reducing their healing received by 20% for 8 sec. At the end of the duration, unleash a creature from the depths dealing COND(GT(FroP, NatP), 83+0+FroP*1, 83+0+NatP*1) Frost Damage.

Each time you generate a stack of Conductive you increase their damage taken from this effect, stacking up to 5 times.
